note: The fourth ḥizb, recited on Thursday — blessings and intercession upon the Prophet ﷺ, prayers for the believers, and a supplication by the tremendous Names of God. Five verses are marked to be recited three times, and the third quarter of the Dalāʾil opens partway through.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِكَ وَرَسُولِكَ النَّبِيِّ الْأُمِّيِّ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿabdika wa rasūlika an-nabiyyil-ummiyy, wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammad.
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad Your slave and Your Messenger, the Unlettered Prophet, and the family of our master Muhammad.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَاةً تَكُونُ لَكَ رِضًا وَلَهُ جَزَاءً وَلِحَقِّهِ أَدَاءً ۞ وَأَعْطِهِ الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ وَالْمَقَامَ الْمَحْمُودَ الَّذِي وَعَدْتَّهُ وَاجْزِهِ عَنَّا مَا هُوَ أَهْلُهُ وَاجْزِهِ أَفْضَلَ مَا جَازَيْتَ نَبِيًّا عَنْ قَوْمِهِ وَرَسُولًا عَنْ أُمَّتِهِ ۞ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى جَمِيعِ إِخْوَانِهِ مِنَ النَّبِيِّينَ وَالصَّالِحِينَ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammad, ṣalātan takūnu laka riḍā wa lahu jazāʾā, wa li-ḥaqqihi adāʾā, wa aʿṭihil-wasīlata wal-faḍīlata wal-maqāmal-maḥmūd alladhī waʿadtahu, wajzihi ʿannā mā huwa ahluh, wajzihi afḍala mā jāzayta nabiyyan ʿan qawmih, wa rasūlan ʿan ummatih, wa ṣalli ʿalā jamīʿi ikhwānihi mina an-nabiyyīna waṣ-ṣāliḥīn, yā arḥamar-rāḥimīn.
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, blessings which are pleasing to You, a reward for him and which are his dutiful right, and grant him the Closest Access, the Preeminence and the Most Praised Station which You promised him, and reward him our behalf as he deserves and reward him better than You have rewarded on behalf of his people any other Prophet or on behalf of his nation any other Messenger, and bless all his brothers, the Prophets and righteous ones, O Most Merciful of the Merciful.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْ فَضَائِلَ صَلَوَاتِكَ وَشَرَائِفَ زَكَوَاتِكَ وَنَوَامِيَ بَرَكَاتِكَ وَعَوَاطِفَ رَأْفَتِكَ وَرَحْمَتِكَ وَتَحِيَّتِكَ وَفَضَائِلَ آلَائِكَ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ سَيِّدِ الْمُرْسَلِينَ وَرَسُولِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ ۞ قَائِدِ الْخَيْرِ وَفَاتِحِ الْبِرِّ وَنَبِيِّ الرَّحْمَةِ وَسَيِّدِ الْأُمَّةِ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ijʿal faḍāʾila ṣalawātika wa sharāʾifa zakawātika wa nawāmī barakātika wa ʿawāṭifa raʾfatika wa raḥmatika wa taḥiyyatika wa faḍāʾila ālāʾika ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin sayyidil-mursalīn, wa rasūli rabbil-ʿālamīn, qāʾidil-khayr, wa fātiḥil-birr, wa nabiyyir-raḥmah, wa sayyidil-ummah.
verses.en: O Allah, bestow the favours of Your noble blessings and virtues, and the increase of Your benedictions, and the benevolence of Your Compassion, and Your Mercy, and Your Salutations, and the favours of Your bounties, upon our master Muhammad, the Master of the Messengers, the Messenger of the Lord of the Worlds, the Guide to Goodness, the Opener of Piety, the Prophet of Mercy and the Master of the nation.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ ابْعَثْهُ مَقَامًا مَّحْمُودًا ‖ تُزْلِفُ بِهِ قُرْبَهُ وَتُقِرُّ بِهِ عَيْنَهُ يَغْبِطُهُ بِهِ الْأَوَّلُونَ وَالْآخِرُونَ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ibʿath-hu maqāman maḥmūdan tuzlifu bihi qurbah, wa tuqirru bihi ʿaynah, yaghbiṭuhu bihi al-awwalūna wal-ākhirūn.
verses.en: O Allah, send him to the Most Praised Station thereby advancing his nearness, comforting his eyes, and making him the envy of those who came first and those who came last.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ أَعْطِهِ الْفَضْلَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ وَالشَّرَفَ وَالْوَسِيلَةَ وَالدَّرَجَةَ الرَّفِيعَةَ وَالْمَنْزِلَةَ الشَّامِخَةَ
verses.tr: Allāhumma aʿṭihil-faḍla wal-faḍīlah, wash-sharafa wal-wasīlah, wad-darajatar-rafīʿah, wal-manzilatash-shāmikhah.
verses.en: O Allah, grant him Divine Favour, Divine Grace, Divine Honour, the Closest Access, the Lofty Rank and the High Standing.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ أَعْطِ سَيِّدَنَا مُحَمَّدَ نِ الْوَسِيلَةَ وَبَلِّغْهُ مَأْمُولَهُ وَاجْعَلْهُ أَوَّلَ شَافِعٍ وَأَوَّلَ مُشَفَّعٍ
verses.tr: Allāhumma aʿṭi sayyidanā Muḥammadan al-wasīlah, wa balligh-hu maʾmūlah, wajʿal-hu awwala shāfiʿin wa awwala mushaffaʿ.
verses.en: O Allah, grant our master Muhammad the Closest Access and send him what he hopes for and make him the first intercessor and the first whose intercession is accepted.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ عَظِّمْ بُرْهَانَهُ وَثَقِّلْ مِيزَانَهُ وَأَبْلِجْ حُجَّتَهُ وَارْفَعْ فِي أَهْلِ عِلِّيِّينَ دَرَجَتَهُ وَفِي أَعْلَى الْمُقَرَّبِينَ مَنْزِلَتَهُ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ʿaẓẓim burhānah, wa thaqil mīzānah, wa ablij ḥujjatah, warfaʿ fī ahli ʿilliyyīn darajatah, wa fī aʿlal-muqarrabīn manzilatah.
verses.en: O Allah, strengthen his proof, make his judgement sound, make his argument shine and raise his rank among the dwellers of the Uppermost Heaven. And raise his standing among the Heights of those who are closest.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ أَحْيِنَا عَلٰى سُنَّتِهِ وَتَوَفَّنَا عَلٰى مِلَّتِهِ وَاجْعَلْنَا مِنْ أَهْلِ شَفَاعَتِهِ وَاحْشُرْنَا فِي زُمْرَتِهِ وَأَوْرِدْنَا حَوْضَهُ وَاسْقِنَا مِنْ كَأْسِهِ غَيْرَ خَزَايَا وَلَا نَادِمِينَ وَلَا شَاكِّينَ وَلَا مُبَدِّلِينَ وَلَا مُغَيِّرِينَ وَلَا فَاتِنِينَ وَلَا مَفْتُونِينَ آمِينَ يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ
verses.tr: Allāhumma aḥyinā ʿalā sunnatih, wa tawaffanā ʿalā millatih, wajʿalnā min ahli shafāʿatih, waḥshurnā fī zumratih, wa awridnā ḥawḍah, wasqinā min kaʾsih, ghayra khazāyā wa lā nādimīn, wa lā shākkīn, wa lā mubaddilīn, wa lā mughayyirīn, wa lā fātinīn, wa lā maftūnīn. Āmīn yā rabbal-ʿālamīn.
verses.en: O Allah, cause us to live according to his way. And pass away following his religion. And make us among the People of his intercession. And resurrect us in his company and make us to be watered from his Pool. And to drink from his bowl with no disgrace, no regrets, no doubts, no temptations, amen, O Lord of the Worlds.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَأَعْطِهِ الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ، وَالدَّرَجَةَ الرَّفِيعَةَ ‖ وَابْعَثْهُ الْمَقَامَ الْمَحْمُودَ الَّذِي وَعَدْتَّهُ مَعَ إِخْوَانِهِ النَّبِيِّينَ ۞ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ نَبِيِّ الرَّحْمَةِ، وَسَيِّدِ الْأُمَّةِ، وَعَلٰى أَبِينَا سَيِّدِنَا آدَمَ وَأُمِّنَا سَيِّدَتِنَا حَوَّاءَ، وَمَنْ وَلَدَا مِنَ النَّبِيِّينَ وَالصِّدِّيقِينَ وَالشُّهَدَاءِ وَالصَّالِحِينَ ۞ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى مَلَائِكَتِكَ أَجْمَعِينَ، مِنْ أَهْلِ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِينَ، وَعَلَيْنَا مَعَهُمْ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammad, wa aʿṭihil-wasīlata wal-faḍīlah, wad-darajatar-rafīʿah, wabʿath-hul-maqāmal-maḥmūd alladhī waʿadtah, maʿa ikhwānihin-nabiyyīn. Wa ṣallallāhu ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammad nabiyyir-raḥmah, wa sayyidil-ummah, wa ʿalā abīnā sayyidinā Ādam, wa umminā sayyidatinā Ḥawwāʾ, wa man waladā minan-nabiyyīn waṣ-ṣiddīqīn wash-shuhadāʾ waṣ-ṣāliḥīn. Wa ṣalli ʿalā malāʾikatika ajmaʿīn min ahli as-samāwāti wal-arḍīn, wa ʿalaynā maʿahum yā arḥamar-rāḥimīn.
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, and grant him the Closest Access, the Pre-eminence and Lofty Rank and send him to the Most Praised Station which You promised him, with his brother Prophets. The blessings of Allah be upon our master Muhammad, the Prophet of Mercy and the Master of his nation, and upon our father, our master Adam, and upon our Mother our lady Eve, and upon all the off spring of the Prophets, the truthful ones, the martyrs and the righteous ones, and bless all Your angels among the folk of the Heavens and the Earths and upon us along with them, O Most Merciful of the Merciful.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذُنُوبِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَارْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِي صَغِيرًا ۞ وَلِجَمِيعِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ، وَالْمُسْلِمِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمَاتِ الْأَحْيَاءِ مِنْهُمْ وَالْأَمْوَاتِ، وَتَابِعْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُمْ بِالخَيْرَاتِ ﴿رَّبِّ اغْفِرْ وَارْحَمْ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الرّٰحِمِينَ﴾ ۞ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا باللّٰهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ighfir lī dhunūbī wa li-wālidayya, warḥamhumā kamā rabbayānī ṣaghīrā, wa li-jamīʿil-muʾminīna wal-muʾmināt, wal-muslimīna wal-muslimāt, al-aḥyāʾi minhum wal-amwāt, wa tābiʿ baynanā wa baynahum bil-khayrāt. Rabbighfir warḥam wa anta khayrur-rāḥimīn. Wa lā ḥawla wa lā quwwata illā billāhil-ʿaliyyil-ʿaẓīm.
verses.en: O Allah, forgive me my sins and my parents, and bestow mercy upon then even as they cherished me in childhood, and all the believing men and women, all the surrendering men and women, the living and dead, and may blessings ensue on us, O Lord, forgive, bestow mercy, and You are the Best of the Merciful. And there is no help or power save through Allah, the High, the Great.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ نُورِ الْأَنْوَارِ، وَسِرِّ الْأَسْرَارِ، وَسَيِّدِ الْأَبْرَارِ، وَزَيْنِ الْمُرْسَلِينَ الْأَخْيَارِ، وَأَكْرَمِ مَنْ أَظْلَمَ ‖ عَلَيْهِ اللَّيْلُ وَأَشْرَقَ عَلَيْهِ النَّهَارُ، وَعَدَدَ مَا نَزَلَ مِنْ أَوَّلِ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى آخِرِهَا مِنْ قَطْرِ الْأَمْطَارِ، وَعَدَدَ مَا نَبَتَ مِنْ أَوَّلِ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى آخِرِهَا مِنَ النَّبَاتِ وَالْأَشْجَارِ ۞ صَلَاةً دَائِمَةً بِدَوَامِ مُلْكِ اللّٰهِ الْوَاحِدِ الْقَهَّارِ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin nūr il-anwār, wa sirr il-asrār, wa sayyid il-abrār, wa zayn il-mursalīn al-akhyār, wa akrami man aẓlama ʿalayhil-laylu wa ashraqa ʿalayhin-nahār, wa ʿadada mā nazala min awwalid-dunyā ilā ākhirihā min qaṭril-amṭār, wa ʿadada mā nabata min awwalid-dunyā ilā ākhirihā minan-nabāti wal-ashjār, ṣalātan dāʾimatan bidawāmi mulkillāhil-wāḥidil-qahhār.
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad, the Light of Lights, the Secret of Secrets, the Master of the Pious, the Adornment of the Messengers, the Chosen One, the Most Noble One, the night has ever cloaked and the day has ever bathed in light, in every drop of rain which has fallen from the beginning of this world until its end, and in every plant and in every tree which have grown from the beginning of this world to its end, blessings which are eternal, lasting as long as the Dominion of Allah, the One, the Powerful.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَاةً تُكْرِمُ بِهَا مَثْوَاهُ، وَتُشَرِّفُ بِهَا عُقْبَاهُ، وَتُبَلِّغُ بِهَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مُنَاهُ وَرِضَاهُ (3)
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalātan tukrimu bihā mathwāh, wa tusharrifu bihā ʿuqbāh, wa tuballighu bihā yawmal-qiyāmati munāh wa riḍāh. (3)
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad, blessings which ennoble his Place of Rest, honour his final destination, and on the Day of Resurrection bring him his heart’s desire and contentment. (3)

verses.ar: هٰذِهِ الصَّلَاةُ تَعْظِيمًا لِحَقِّكَ يَا سَيِّدَنَا مُحَمَّدُ (3)
verses.tr: Hādhihis-ṣalātu taʿẓīman li-ḥaqqika yā sayyidanā Muḥammad. (3)
verses.en: These great blessings are your right, O our master Muhammad. (3)

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ حَاءِ الرَّحْمَةِ، وَمِيمَيِ الْمُلْكِ، وَدَالِ الدَّوَامِ، السَّيِّدِ الْكَامِلِ الْفَاتِحِ الْخَاتِمِ، عَدَدَ مَا فِي عِلْمِكَ كَائِنٌ أَوْ قَدْ كَانَ، كُلَّمَا ذَكَرَكَ وَذَكَرَهُ الذَّاكِرُونَ، وَكُلَّمَا غَفَلَ عَنْ ذِكْرِكَ وَذِكْرِهِ الْغَافِلُونَ ۞ صَلَاةً دَائِمَةً بِدَوَامِكَ، بَاقِيَةً بِبَقَائِكَ، لَا مُنْتَهَى لَهَا دُونَ عِلْمِكَ، إِنَّكَ عَلٰى كُلِّ ‖ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ (3)
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ḥāʾir-raḥmah, wa mīmayil-mulk, wa dāl id-dawām, as-sayyidil-kāmil, al-fātiḥil-khātim; ʿadada mā fī ʿilmika kāʾinun aw qad kān, kullamā dhakaraka wa dhakarah adh-dhākirūn, wa kullamā ghafala ʿan dhikrika wa dhikrih il-ghāfilūn; ṣalātan dāʾimatan bidawāmik, bāqiyatan bi-baqāʾik, lā muntahā lahā dūna ʿilmik, innaka ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr. (3)
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad, the ‘Ha’ (the middle letter of the Rahmah) of Mercy, The Mim’ (the first of the letter of Mulk) of Sovereignty, And the ‘Dal’ (the first letter of Da’im) of Eternity, the perfect master the Opener, the Seal, as much as Your knowledge, now or before and whenever You are remembered and he is remembered by whose who remember and whenever You are forgotten and he is forgotten by those who forget. Blessings which are eternal, lasting as long You last enduring as long as You endure, and with no end without Your knowledge, for You are the Power over all things (3)

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدِ نِ النَّبِيِّ الْأُمِّيِّ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدِ نِ الَّذِي هُوَ أَبْهَى شُمُوسِ الْهُدَى نُورًا وَأَبْهَرُهَا، وَأَسْيَرُ الْأَنْبِيَاءِ فَخْرًا وَأَشْهَرُهَا، وَنُورُهُ أَزْهَرُ أَنْوَارِ الْأَنْبِيَاءِ وَأَشْرَفُهَا وَأَوْضَحُهَا، وَأَزْكَى الْخَلِيقَةِ أَخْلَاقًا وَأَطْهَرُهَا، وَأَكْرَمُهَا خَلْقًا وَأَعْدَلُهَا
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin an-nabiyyil-ummiyy, wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammad, alladhī huwa abhā shumūsil-hudā nūran wa abharuhā, wa asyarul-anbiyāʾi fakhran wa ashharuhā, wa nūruhu azharu anwāril-anbiyāʾi wa ashrafuhā wa awḍaḥuhā, wa azkā al-khalīqati akhlāqan wa aṭharuhā, wa akramuhā khalqan wa aʿdaluhā.
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad, the Unlettered Prophet, and the family of our master Muhammad, him whose light is the most beautiful and most dazzling of all the suns of guidance. And whose conduct and glory are the best and most renowned of all the Prophets. And whose light is more radiant, more noble and more brilliant than the lights of the Prophets, and who has the purest and most iimmaculate manners in creation, and who is the most just and generous creature.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدِ نِ النَّبِيِّ الْأُمِّيِّ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدِ نِ الَّذِي هُوَ أَبْهَى مِنَ الْقَمَرِ التَّامِّ، وَأَكْرَمُ مِنَ السَّحَابِ الْمُرْسَلَةِ وَالْبَحْرِ الْخِضَمِّ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin an-nabiyyil-ummiyy, wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammad, alladhī huwa abhā minal-qamarit-tāmm, wa akramu minas-saḥābil-mursalati wal-baḥril-khiḍamm.
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad, the Unlettered Prophet, and the family of our master Muhammad, him who is more beautiful than the full moon, more noble than the flowing clouds and the raging sea.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ النَّبِيِّ الْأُمِّيِّ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدِ نِ الَّذِي قُرِنَتِ الْبَرَكَةُ بِذَاتِهِ وَمَحْيَاهُ، وَتَعَطَّرَتِ الْعَوَالِمُ بِطِيبِ ذِكْرِهِ وَرَيَّاهُ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin an-nabiyyil-ummiyy, wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammad, alladhī qurinat al-barakatu bidhātih wa maḥyāh, wa taʿaṭṭarat al-ʿawālim biṭībi dhikrih wa rayyāh.
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad, the Unlettered Prophet, and the family of our master Muhammad, him with whose essence and life blessing has been joined, and the remembrance of whom perfumes and sweetens all the worlds.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِهِ وَسَلِّمْ ۞ اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ، وَبَارِكْ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ، وَارْحَمْ سَيِّدَنَا مُحَمَّدًا وَآلَ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا ‖ صَلَّيْتَ وَبَارَكْتَ وَتَرَحَّمْتَ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَّجِيدٌ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā ālihī wa sallim. Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammad, wa bārik ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammad, warḥam sayyidinā Muḥammadan wa āla sayyidinā Muḥammad, kamā ṣallayta wa bārakta wa taraḥḥamta ʿalā sayyidinā Ibrāhīm wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Ibrāhīm, innaka ḥamīdun majīd.
verses.en: O Allah, bless and grant peace to our master Muhammad, and his family. O Allah, bless our master Muhammad, and the family of our master Muhammad, and bestow grace upon our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, and bestow mercy upon our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, just as You blessed, bestowed grace and bestowed mercy upon our master Abraham and the family of our master Abraham, for You are the Praiseworthy, the Mighty.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِكَ وَنَبِيِّكَ وَرَسُولِكَ النَّبِيِّ الْأُمِّيِّ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿabdika wa nabiyyika wa rasūlika an-nabiyyil-ummiyy, wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammad.
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad, Your slave, Your Prophet and Your Messenger, the Unlettered Prophet, and the family of our master Muhammad.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ مِّلْءَ الدُّنْيَا وَمِلْءَ الْآخِرَةِ ۞ وَبَارِكْ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ مِّلْءَ الدُّنْيَا وَمِلْءَ الْآخِرَةِ ۞ وَارْحَمْ سَيِّدَنَا مُحَمَّدًا وَآلَ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ مِّلْءَ الدُّنْيَا وَمِلْءَ الْآخِرَةِ ۞ وَاجْزِ سَيِّدَنَا مُحَمَّدًا وَآلَ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ مِّلْءَ الدُّنْيَا وَمِلْءَ الْآخِرَةِ ۞ وَسَلِّمْ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ مِلْءَ الدُّنْيَا وَمِلْءَ الْآخِرَةِ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammad milʾad-dunyā wa milʾal-ākhirah, wa bārik ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammad milʾad-dunyā wa milʾal-ākhirah, warḥam sayyidinā Muḥammadan wa āla sayyidinā Muḥammad milʾad-dunyā wa milʾal-ākhirah, wajzi sayyidinā Muḥammadan wa āla sayyidinā Muḥammad milʾad-dunyā wa milʾal-ākhirah, wa sallim ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammad milʾad-dunyā wa milʾal-ākhirah.
verses.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad, as much as the world and as much as the Hereafter. And bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, as much as the world and as much as the Hereafter. And have mercy on our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, as much as the world and as much as the Hereafter. And reward our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, as much as the world and as much as the Hereafter. And grant peace to our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, as much as the world and as much as the Hereafter.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا أَمَرْتَنَا أَنْ نُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ ۞ وَصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ كَمَا يَنْبَغِي أَنْ يُصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin kamā amartanā an nuṣalliya ʿalayh, wa ṣalli ʿalayh kamā yanbaghī an yuṣallā ʿalayh.
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad as You ordered us to ask for blessings upon him. and bless our master Muhammad as he should be blessed.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ نَبِيِّكَ الْمُصْطَفَى، وَرَسُولِكَ الْمُرْتَضَى، وَوَلِيِّكَ الْمُجْتَبَى، وَأَمِينِكَ عَلٰى وَحْيِ السَّمَاءِ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin nabiyyikal-muṣṭafā, wa rasūlikal-murtaḍā, wa waliyyikal-mujtabā, wa amīnika ʿalā waḥyis-samāʾ.
verses.en: O Allah, bless Your Prophet, the Chosen One, Your Messenger. the Satisfied One, Your Friend, the Elected One, and Your Custodian of the Celestial Revelation.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ أَكْرَمِ ‖ الْأَسْلَافِ، وَالْقَائِمِ بِالْعَدْلِ وَالْإِنْصَافِ، الْمَنْعُوتِ فِي سُورَةِ الْأَعْرَافِ، الْمُنْتَخَبِ مِنْ أَصْلَابِ الشِّرَافِ، وَالْبُطُونِ الظِّرَافِ، الْمُصَفَّى مِنْ مُصَاصِ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ بْنِ عَبْدِ مَنَافٍ، الَّذِي هَدَيْتَ بِهِ مِنَ الْخِلَافِ، وَبَيَّنْتَ بِهِ سَبِيلَ الْعَفَافِ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin akramil-aslāf, wal-qāʾimi bil-ʿadli wal-inṣāf, al-manʿūti fī sūratil-aʿrāf, al-muntakhabi min aṣlābish-shirāf, wal-buṭūniẓ-ẓirāf, al-muṣaffā min muṣāṣi ʿAbdil-Muṭṭalib ibn ʿAbdi Manāf, alladhī hadayta bihi minal-khilāf, wa bayyanta bihi sabīlal-ʿafāf.
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad, the most noble ancestor, the Upholder of Justice and Equity, the One described in surah Al’Araf. One Chosen from the noble loins and refined wombs and the One distilled from the pure essence of Abd al-Muttalib, son of Abd Manaf, through whom You guided from deviation and through whom You made clear the path of chastity.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِأَفْضَلِ مَسْأَلَتِكَ، وَبِأَحَبِّ أَسْمَائِكَ إِلَيْكَ، وَأَكْرَمِهَا عَلَيْكَ، وَبِمَا مَنَنْتَ عَلَيْنَا بِسَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ نَبِيِّنَا صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ ۞ فَاسْتَنْقَذْتَنَا بِهِ مِنَ الضَّلَالَةِ، وَأَمَرْتَنَا بِالصَّلَاةِ عَلَيْهِ، وَجَعَلْتَ صَلَاتَنَا عَلَيْهِ دَرَجَةً وَكَفَّارَةً وَلُطْفًا وَمَنًّا مِنْ إِعْطَائِكَ، فَأَدْعُوكَ تَعْظِيمًا لِأَمْرِكَ، وَاتِّبَاعًا لِوَصِيَّتِكَ، وَمُنْتَجِزًا لِمَوْعُودِكَ، لِمَا يَجِبُ لِنَبِيِّنَا سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي أَدَاءِ حَقِّهِ قِبَلَنَا، إِذْ آمَنَّا بِهِ وَصَدَّقْنَاهُ، وَاتَّبَعْنَا النُّورَ الَّذِي أُنْزِلَ ‖ مَعَهُ، وَقُلْتَ وَقَوْلُكَ الْحَقُّ : ﴿إِنَّ اللّٰهَ وَمَلَائِكَتَهۥ يُصَلُّونَ عَلٰى النَّبِيِّ، يَأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا صَلُّوا عَلَيْهِ وَسَلِّمُوا تَسْلِيمًا﴾ ۞ وَأَمَرْتَ الْعِبَادَ بِالصَّلَاةِ عَلٰى نَبِيِّهِمْ، فَرِيضَةَ نِ افْتَرَضْتَهَا وَأَمَرْتَهُمْ بِهَا، فَنَسْأَلُكَ بِجَلَالِ وَجْهِكَ، وَنُورِ عَظَمَتِكَ، وَبِمَا أَوْجَبْتَ عَلٰى نَفْسِكَ، أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ أَنْتَ وَمَلَائِكَتُكَ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِكَ وَرَسُولِكَ، وَنَبِيِّكَ وَصَفِيِّكَ، وَخِيَرَتِكَ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ، أَفْضَلَ مَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلٰى أَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَّجِيدٌ
verses.tr: Allāhumma innī asʾaluka bi-afḍali masʾalatika, wa bi-aḥabbi asmāʾika ilayk, wa akramihā ʿalayk, wa bimā mananta ʿalaynā bisayyidinā Muḥammadin nabiyyinā ṣallallāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam, fastanqadhtanā bihi minaḍ-ḍalālah, wa amartanā biṣ-ṣalāti ʿalayh, wa jaʿalta ṣalātanā ʿalayhi darajatan wa kaffāratan wa luṭfan wa mannan min iʿṭāʾik. Fa-adʿūka taʿẓīman li-amrik, wattibāʿan li-waṣiyyatik, wa muntajizan li-mawʿūdika, limā yajibu linabiyyinā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣallallāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam fī adāʾi ḥaqqihi qibalanā, idh āmannā bihī wa ṣaddaqnāh, wattabaʿnā an-nūra alladhī unzila maʿah. Wa qulta wa qawluka al-ḥaqq: “Inna Allāha wa malāʾikatahu yuṣallūna ʿalan-nabī, yā ayyuhalladhīna āmanū ṣallū ʿalayhi wa sallimū taslīmā.” Wa amarta al-ʿibāda biṣ-ṣalāti ʿalā nabiyyihim farīḍatan iftaraḍtahā wa amartahum bihā. Fa-nasʾaluka bijalāli wajhik, wa nūri ʿaẓamatik, wa bimā awjabta ʿalā nafsik, an tuṣalliya anta wa malāʾikatuka ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿabdika wa rasūlik, wa nabiyyik wa ṣafiyyik, wa khīratik min khalqik, afḍala mā ṣallayta ʿalā aḥadin min khalqik, innaka ḥamīdun majīd.
verses.en: O Allah, I beseech You by the most superior beseeching, in the most loved of Your Names, in the most noble of Your Names, and for the sake of the fact that You blessed us with our master Muhammad, the blessings and peace of Allah, be upon him, saving us through him from error. And for the sake of the fact that You ordered us to ask for blessings upon him and for the sake of the fact that You made our asking blessings upon him a means of raising our rank, an expiation for our sins, and grace and favour for us. Out of obedience to You, I call on You, exalting Your command, following Your Instruction and fulfilling Your Promise, to render unto our Prophet, our master Muhammad, the blessings and peace of Allah be upon him, what is due from us, for we have faith in him and we believe in him and we follow the light which came down with him and You said, and Your Word is the Truth, ‘Allah and His angels bless the Prophet, O you who believe, ask (Allah) to bless him and grant him abundant peace’. And for sake of the fact that You made it obligatory for the slaves to ask for blessings upon their Prophet making it an obligation and making it binding on them, I ask You for the sake of the Majesty of Your Face and the Light of Your Greatness, and for the sake of that which You have made binding on You in respect of the virtuous, that You and Your angels bless our master Muhammad, Your slave, Your Messenger, Your prophet, Your Pure One and Your Treasure from Your creation, the best blessings ever bestowed upon anyone of Your creation, for You are the Praiseworthy, the mighty.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ ارْفَعْ دَرَجَتَهُ وَأَكْرِمْ مَّقَامَهُ، وَثَقِّلْ مِيزَانَهُ، وَأَبْلِجْ حُجَّتَهُ، وَأَظْهِرْ مِلَّتَهُ، وَأَجْزِلْ ثَوَابَهُ، وَأَضِئْ نُورَهُ، وَأَدِمْ كَرَامَتَهُ، وَأَلْحِقْ بِهِ مِنْ ذُرِّيَّتِهِ وَأَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ مَا تُقِرُّ بِهِ عَيْنَهُ، وَعَظِّمْهُ فِي النَّبِيِّينَ الَّذِينَ خَلَوْا قَبْلَهُ ۞ اللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْ سَيِّدَنَا مُحَمَّدًا أَكْثَرَ النَّبِيِّينَ تَبَعًا، وَأَكْثَرَهُمْ وُزَرَاءَ، وَأَفْضَلَهُمْ كَرَامَةً وَنُورًا، وَأَعْلَاهُمْ ‖ دَرَجَةً، وَأَفْسَحَهُمْ فِي الْجَنَّةِ مَنْزِلًا
verses.tr: Allāhumma irfaʿ darajatah, wa akrim maqāmah, wa thaqil mīzānah, wa ablij ḥujjatah, wa aẓhir millatah, wa ajzil thawābah, wa aḍiʾ nūrah, wa adim karāmatah, wa alḥiq bihi min dhurriyyatih wa ahli baytih mā tuqirru bihi ʿaynah, wa ʿaẓẓimhu fī an-nabiyyīna alladhīna khalaw min qablih. Allāhumma ijʿal sayyidanā Muḥammadan akthara an-nabiyyīna tabaʿan, wa aktharahum wuzarāʾ, wa afḍalahum karāmatan wa nūran, wa aʿlāhum darajatan, wa afsaḥahum fī al-jannati manzilan.
verses.en: O Allah, raise his rank and honor his station, make his scale of good deeds heavy, make his proof and argument clear and established, make his religion manifest, increase his reward abundantly, illuminate his light, and continue his honor. And join to him from his descendants and his family of the Household of his Noble Family those by whom You gladden his eye. And magnify him among the Prophets who came before him. O Allah, make our master Muhammad the Prophet with the most followers among the Prophets, the most helpers among them, the greatest in honor and light, the highest in rank, and the most spacious in dwelling in Paradise.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْ فِي السَّابِقِينَ غَايَتَهُ، وَفِي الْمُنْتَخَبِينَ مَنْزِلَهُ، وَفِي الْمُقَرَّبِينَ دَارَهُ، وَفِي الْمُصْطَفَيْنَ مَنْزِلَهُ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ijʿal fī as-sābiqīn ghāyatah, wa fī al-muntakhabīn manzilah, wa fī al-muqarrabīn dārah, wa fī al-muṣṭafayn manzilah.
verses.en: O Allah, make him the foremost among the foremost, grant him his place among the chosen, place his abode among those brought near, and assign him his place among the elect.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْهُ أَكْرَمَ الْأَكْرَمِينَ عِنْدَكَ مَنْزِلًا، وَأَفْضَلَهُمْ ثَوَابًا، وَأَقْرَبَهُمْ مَجْلِسًا، وَأَثْبَتَهُمْ مَقَامًا، وَأَصْوَبَهُمْ كَلَامًا، وَأَنْجَحَهُمْ مَسْأَلَةً، وَأَفْضَلَهُمْ لَدَيْكَ نَصِيبًا، وَأَعْظَمَهُمْ فِيمَا عِنْدَكَ رَغْبَةً، وَأَنْزِلْهُ فِي غُرُفَاتِ الْفِرْدَوْسِ مِنَ الدَّرَجَاتِ الْعُلَى الَّتِي لَا دَرَجَةَ فَوْقَهَا
verses.tr: Allāhumma ijʿalhu akramal-akramīna ʿindaka manzilan, wa afḍalahum thawāban, wa aqrabahum majlisan, wa athbatahum maqāman, wa aṣwabahum kalāman, wa anjaḥahum masʾalatan, wa afḍalahum ladayka naṣīban, wa aʿẓamahum fīmā ʿindaka raghbatan, wa anzilhu fī ghurufāt il-firdawsi min ad-darajāt il-ʿulā allatī lā darajata fawqahā.
verses.en: O Allah, make him the most honored of the honored in rank with You, the greatest in reward, the nearest in closeness, the most firmly established in station, the most correct in speech, the most successful in supplication, the most favored in share with You, and the greatest in longing for what is with You. And place him in the chambers of the highest Paradise, among the loftiest ranks above which there is no higher rank.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْ سَيِّدَنَا مُحَمَّدًا أَصْدَقَ قَائِلٍ، وَأَنْجَحَ سَائِلٍ، وَأَوَّلَ شَافِعٍ، وَأَفْضَلَ مُشَفَّعٍ، وَشَفِّعْهُ فِي أُمَّتِهِ بِشَفَاعَةٍ يَّغْبِطُهُ بِهَا الْأَوَّلُونَ وَالْآخِرُونَ ۞ وَإِذَا مَيَّزْتَ عِبَادَكَ بِفَصْلِ قَضَائِكَ، فَاجْعَلْ سَيِّدَنَا مُحَمَّدًا فِي الْأَصْدَقِينَ قِيلًا، وَالْأَحْسَنِينَ عَمَلًا، وَفِي الْمَهْدِيِّينَ سَبِيلًا
verses.tr: Allāhumma ijʿal sayyidanā Muḥammadan aṣdaqa qāʾil, wa anjaḥa sāʾil, wa awwala shāfiʿ, wa afḍala mushaffaʿ, wa shaffiʿhu fī ummatih bi-shafāʿatin yaghbiṭuhu bihā al-awwalūna wal-ākhirūn. Wa idhā mayyazta ʿibādaka bi-faṣli qaḍāʾik, fajʿal sayyidanā Muḥammadan fī al-aṣdaqīna qīlan, wa al-aḥsanīna ʿamalan, wa fī al-mahdiyyīna sabīlan.
verses.en: O Allah, make our master Muhammad the most truthful in speech, the most successful in supplication, the first intercessor and the best whose intercession is accepted. Grant him intercession for his community an intercession admired by the first and the last generations. And when You distinguish Your servants by Your decisive judgment, then place our master Muhammad among those most truthful in speech, among those best in deeds, and among those rightly guided in path.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْ نَبِيَّنَا لَنَا فَرَطًا، وَاجْعَلْ ‖ حَوْضَهُ لَنَا مَوْعِدًا لِّأَوَّلِنَا وَآخِرِنَا
verses.tr: Allāhumma ijʿal nabiyyana lanā faraṭan, wajʿal ḥawḍahu lanā mawʿidan li-awwalinā wa ākhirinā.
verses.en: O Allah, make our Prophet a forerunner for us, and make his pool a meeting place for all of us the first of us and the last.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ احْشُرْنَا فِي زُمْرَتِهِ ۞ وَاسْتَعْمِلْنَا فِي سُنَّتِهِ، وَتَوَفَّنَا عَلٰى مِلَّتِهِ، وَعَرِّفْنَا وَجْهَهُ، وَاجْعَلْنَا فِي زُمْرَتِهِ وَحِزْبِهِ
verses.tr: Allāhumma uḥshurnā fī zumratih, wastaʿmilnā fī sunnatih, wa tawaffanā ʿalā millatih, wa ʿarrifnā wajhah, wajʿalnā fī zumratih wa ḥizbih.
verses.en: O Allah, gather us in his company, enable us to follow his way, cause us to die upon his religion, allow us to recognize his blessed face, and make us among his group and his party.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ اجْمَعْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُ كَمَا آمَنَّا بِهِ وَلَمْ نَرَهُ ۞ وَلَا تُفَرِّقْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُ حَتَّى تُدْخِلَنَا مَدْخَلَهُ، وَتُورِدَنَا حَوْضَهُ وَتَجْعَلَنَا مِنْ رُفَقَائِهِ، مَعَ الْمُنْعَمِ عَلَيْهِمْ مِّنَ النَّبِيِّينَ وَالصِّدِّيقِينَ وَالشُّهَدَاءِ وَالصَّالِحِينَ وَحَسُنَ أُوْلَئِكَ رَفِيقًا ۞ وَالحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ijmaʿ baynanā wa baynahu kamā āmannā bihī wa lam narah, wa lā tufarriq baynanā wa baynahu ḥattā tudkhilanā madkhalah, wa tūridnā ḥawḍah, wa tajʿalanā min rufaqāʾih, maʿa al-munʿam ʿalayhim mina an-nabiyyīn waṣ-ṣiddīqīn wash-shuhadāʾ waṣ-ṣāliḥīn, wa ḥasuna ulāʾika rafīqā. Wal-ḥamdu lillāhi rabbil-ʿālamīn.
verses.en: O Allah, bring us together with him just as we have believed in him without seeing him. Do not separate us from him until You admit us to his entrance, allow us to reach his pool, and make us among his companions along with those whom You have favored: the Prophets, the truthful, the martyrs, and the righteous and excellent are those as companions. All praise is for Allah, Lord of all the worlds.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ نُورِ الْهُدَى، وَالْقَائِدِ إِلَى الْخَيْرِ، وَالدَّاعِي إِلَى الرُّشْدِ، نَبِيِّ الرَّحْمَةِ، وَإِمَامِ الْمُتَّقِينَ، وَرَسُولِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ ۞ لَا نَبِيَّ بَعْدَهُ، كَمَا بَلَّغَ رِسَالَتَكَ، وَنَصَحَ لِعِبَادِكَ، وَتَلَا آيَاتِكَ، وَأَقَامَ حُدُودَكَ، وَوَفَّى بِعَهْدِكَ، وَأَنْفَذَ حُكْمَكَ ‖ وَأَمَرَ بِطَاعَتِكَ، وَنَهَى عَنْ مَّعْصِيَتِكَ، وَوَالَى وَلِيَّكَ الَّذِي تُحِبُّ أَنْ تُوَالِيَهُ، وَعَادَى عَدُوَّكَ الَّذِي تُحِبُّ أَنْ تُعَادِيَهُ ۞ وَصَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin nūr al-hudā, wal-qāʾidi ilā al-khayr, wad-dāʿī ilā ar-rushd, nabiyyir-raḥmah, wa imām al-muttaqīn, wa rasūli rabbil-ʿālamīn, lā nabiyya baʿdah. Kamā ballagha risālatak, wa naṣaḥa li-ʿibādik, wa talā āyātik, wa aqāma ḥudūdak, wa waffā bi-ʿahdik, wa anfadha ḥukmak, wa amara bi-ṭāʿatik, wa nahā ʿan maʿṣiyatik, wa wālā waliyyak alladhī tuḥibbu an tuwāliya, wa ʿādā ʿaduwwak alladhī tuḥibbu an tuʿādiya. Wa ṣallallāhu ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammad.
verses.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad the light of guidance, the leader to goodness, the caller to right guidance, the Prophet of mercy, the leader of the God-conscious, and the Messenger of the Lord of all the worlds, there is no prophet after him. As he conveyed Your message, sincerely advised Your servants, recited Your verses, established Your laws, fulfilled Your covenant, carried out Your command, enjoined obedience to You, forbade disobedience to You, befriended those whom You love to be befriended, and opposed those whom You love to be opposed. And may Allah send blessings upon our master Muhammad.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى جَسَدِهِ فِي الْأَجْسَادِ، وَعَلٰى رُوحِهِ فِي الْأَرْوَاحِ، وَعَلٰى مَوْقِفِهِ فِي الْمَوَاقِفِ، وَعَلٰى مَشْهَدِهِ فِي الْمَشَاهِدِ، وَعَلٰى ذِكْرِهِ إِذَا ذُكِرَ، صَلَاةً مِّنَّا عَلٰى نَبِيِّنَا
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā jasadihī fī al-ajsād, wa ʿalā rūḥihī fī al-arwāḥ, wa ʿalā mawqifihī fī al-mawāqif, wa ʿalā mashhadihī fī al-mashāhid, wa ʿalā dhikrihī idhā dhukira, ṣalātan minnā ʿalā nabiyyinā.
verses.en: O Allah, send blessings upon his body among the bodies, upon his soul among the souls, upon his standing among all stands, upon his presence among all gatherings, and upon his remembrance whenever he is mentioned, blessings from us upon our Prophet.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ أَبْلِغْهُ مِنَّا السَّلَامَ، كَمَا ذُكِرَ السَّلَامُ، وَالسَّلَامُ عَلٰى النَّبِيِّ، وَرَحْمَةُ اللّٰهِ تَعَالَى وَبَرَكَاتُهُ
verses.tr: Allāhumma abliġhu minnā as-salām, kamā dhukira as-salām, was-salāmu ʿalā an-nabī, wa raḥmatullāhi taʿālā wa barakātuh.
verses.en: O Allah, convey to him our greetings of peace as peace is mentioned, and peace be upon the Prophet, and the mercy of Allah the Most High and His blessings.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مَلَائِكَتِكَ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ، وَعَلٰى أَنْبِيَائِكَ الْمُطَهَّرِينَ، وَعَلٰى رُسُلِكَ الْمُرْسَلِينَ، وَعَلٰى حَمَلَةِ عَرْشِكَ، وَعَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا جِبْرِيلَ، وَسَيِّدِنَا مِيكَائِيلَ، وَسَيِّدِنَا إِسْرَافِيلَ، وَسَيِّدِنَا مَلَكِ الْمَوْتِ، وَرِضْوَانَ خَازِنِ جَنَّتِكَ وَسَيِّدِنَا مَالِكٍ ۞ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى الْكِرَامِ الْكَاتِبِينَ ۞ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى أَهْلِ طَاعَتِكَ أَجْمَعِينَ، مِنْ أَهْلِ السَّمَوَاتِ ‖ وَالْأَرَضِينَ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā malāʾikatika al-muqarrabīn, wa ʿalā anbiyāʾika al-muṭahharīn, wa ʿalā rusulika al-mursalīn, wa ʿalā ḥamalati ʿarshik, wa ʿalā sayyidinā Jibrīl, wa sayyidinā Mīkāʾīl, wa sayyidinā Isrāfīl, wa sayyidinā malakil-mawt, wa Riḍwān khāzin jannatik, wa sayyidinā Mālik, wa ṣalli ʿalā al-kirāmil-kātibīn, wa ṣalli ʿalā ahli ṭāʿatik ajmaʿīn, min ahli as-samāwāti wal-arḍīn.
verses.en: O Allah, send blessings upon Your close angels, upon Your purified Prophets, upon Your sent Messengers, and upon the bearers of Your Throne; upon Gabriel, Michael, and Raphael, and the Angel of Death; upon Ridwan, the keeper of Your Paradise, and upon Malik; and send blessings upon the noble recording angels; and send blessings upon all those who obey You, from the inhabitants of the heavens and the earth.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ آتِ أَهْلَ بَيْتِ نَبِيِّكَ أَفْضَلَ مَا آتَيْتَ أَحَدًا مِنْ أَهْلِ بُيُوتِ الْمُرْسَلِينَ ۞ وَاجْزِ أَصْحَابَ نَبِيِّكَ أَفْضَلَ مَا جَازَيْتَ أَحَدًا مِنْ أَصْحَابِ الْمُرْسَلِينَ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ātī ahla bayti nabiyyika afḍala mā ātayta aḥadan min ahli buyūtil-mursalīn, wajzi aṣḥāba nabiyyika afḍala mā jāzayta aḥadan min aṣḥābil-mursalīn.
verses.en: O Allah, grant the family of Your Prophet the best of what You have granted to any of the families of the Messengers, and reward the companions of Your Prophet with the best of what You have rewarded any of the companions of the Messengers.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ، وَالْمُسْلِمِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمَاتِ الْأَحْيَاءِ مِنْهُمْ وَالْأَمْوَاتِ ﴿وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلِإِخْوَانِنَا الَّذِينَ سَبَقُونَا بِالْإِيمَانِ وَلَا تَجْعَلْ فِي قُلُوبِنَا غِلًّا لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ رَؤُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ﴾
verses.tr: Allāhumma ighfir lil-muʾminīna wal-muʾmināt, wal-muslimīna wal-muslimāt, al-aḥyāʾi minhum wal-amwāt. Wa ighfir lanā wa li-ikhwāninā alladhīna sabaqūnā bil-īmān, wa lā tajʿal fī qulūbinā ghillan lilladhīna āmanū, rabbanā innaka raʾūfun raḥīm.
verses.en: O Allah, forgive the believing men and believing women, and the Muslim men and Muslim women, the living among them and the dead. And forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith, and do not place in our hearts any resentment toward those who believe. Our Lord, indeed You are Most Kind and Most Merciful.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى النَّبِيِّ الْهَاشِمِيِّ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ تَسْلِيمًا
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā an-nabiyyil-hāshimī sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā ālihī wa ṣaḥbihī wa sallim taslīmā.
verses.en: O Allah, send blessings upon the Hashemite Prophet, our master Muhammad, and upon his family and his companions, and grant them perfect peace.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ خَيْرِ الْبَرِيَّةِ، صَلَاةً تُرْضِيكَ وَتُرْضِيهِ، وَتَرْضَى بِهَا عَنَّا يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin khayril-bariyyah, ṣalātan turḍīka wa turḍīh, wa tarḍā bihā ʿannā yā arḥamar-rāḥimīn.
verses.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the best of creation, blessings that please You and please him, and through which You are pleased with us, O Most Merciful of the merciful.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ تَسْلِيمًا كَثِيرًا طَيِّبًا مُبَارَكًا فِيهِ، جَزِيلًا جَمِيلًا، دَائِمًا بِدَوَامِ مُلْكِ اللّٰهِ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā ālihī wa ṣaḥbihī wa sallim taslīman kathīran ṭayyiban mubārakan fīh, jazīlan jamīlan, dāʾiman bidawāmi mulkillāh.
verses.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, and upon his family and his companions, and grant them abundant, pure, and blessed peace, great, beautiful, and everlasting, as everlasting as the dominion of Allah.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ ‖ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِهِ مِلْءَ الْفَضَاءِ، وَعَدَدَ النُّجُومِ فِي السَّمَاءِ، صَلَاةً تُوَازِنُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ، وَعَدَدَ مَا خَلَقْتَ وَمَا أَنْتَ خَالِقُهُ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā ālihī milʾ al-faḍāʾ, wa ʿadada an-nujūmi fī as-samāʾ, ṣalātan tuwāzin as-samāwāti wal-arḍ, wa ʿadada mā khalaqta wa mā anta khāliquhu ilā yawmil-qiyāmah.
verses.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon his family, as vast as space and as many as the stars in the sky, blessings that equal the heavens and the earth, and the number of all that You have created and all that You will create until the Day of Judgment.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ ۞ وَبَارِكْ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ فِي الْعَالَمِينَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَّجِيدٌ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammad, kamā ṣallayta ʿalā sayyidinā Ibrāhīm. Wa bārik ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammad, kamā bārakta ʿalā sayyidinā Ibrāhīm wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Ibrāhīm fī al-ʿālamīn, innaka ḥamīdun majīd.
verses.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad, as You sent blessings upon our master Abraham. And bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, as You blessed our master Abraham and the family of our master Abraham among all the worlds. Indeed, You are Praiseworthy, Glorious.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالعَافِيَةَ فِي الدِّينِ وَالدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ (3)
verses.tr: Allāhumma innī asʾaluka al-ʿafwa wal-ʿāfiyata fī ad-dīn wa ad-dunyā wal-ākhirah. (3)
verses.en: O Allah, I ask You for forgiveness and well-being in the religion, in this world, and in the Hereafter (recite three times). (3)

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ اسْتُرْنَا بِسِتْرِكَ الْجَمِيلِ (3)
verses.tr: Allāhumma usturnā bi-sitrikal-jamīl. (3)
verses.en: O Allah, conceal us with Your beautiful concealment (recite three times). (3)

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِحَقِّكَ الْعَظِيمِ، وَبِحَقِّ نُورِ وَجْهِكَ الْكَرِيمِ، وَبِحَقِّ عَرْشِكَ الْعَظِيمِ، وَبِمَا حَمَلَ كُرْسِيُّكَ مِنْ عَظَمَتِكَ وَجَلَالِكَ وَجَمَالِكَ، وَبَهَائِكَ وَقُدْرَتِكَ وَسُلْطَانِكَ، وَبِحَقِّ أَسْمَائِكَ الْمَخْزُونَةِ الْمَكْنُونَةِ الَّتِي لَمْ يَطَّلِعْ عَلَيْهَا أَحَدٌ ‖ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ
verses.tr: Allāhumma innī asʾaluka bi-ḥaqqikal-ʿaẓīm, wa bi-ḥaqqi nūri wajhikal-karīm, wa bi-ḥaqqi ʿarshikal-ʿaẓīm, wa bimā ḥamala kursiyyuka min ʿaẓamatika wa jalālika wa jamālika, wa bahāʾika wa qudratika wa sulṭānika, wa bi-ḥaqqi asmāʾikal-makhzūnah al-maknūnah allatī lam yaṭṭaliʿ ʿalayhā aḥadun min khalqik.
verses.en: O Allah, I ask You for the sake of Your Great Truth and for the sake of the Truth of the light of Your Noble Face and for the sake of the Truth of Your Great Throne and for the sake of that which bears Your Chair from Your Strength Oceans, Your Glory Oceans, Your Beauty Oceans, Your Light Oceans, Your Might Oceans and Your Power Oceans and for the sake of the Truth of Your Preserved and Hidden Names which no one from Your Creation will ever come to know.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ وَأَسْأَلُكَ بِالِاسْمِ الَّذِي وَضَعْتَهُ عَلٰى اللَّيْلِ فَأَظْلَمَ، وَعَلٰى النَّهَارِ فَاسْتَنَارَ، وَعَلٰى السَّمَوَاتِ فَاسْتَقَلَّتْ، وَعَلٰى الْأَرْضِ فَاسْتَقَرَّتْ، وَعَلٰى الْجِبَالِ فَرَسَتْ، وَعَلٰى الْبِحَارِ وَالْأَوْدِيَةِ فَجَرَتْ، وَعَلٰى الْعُيُونِ فَنَبَعَتْ، وَعَلٰى السَّحَابِ فَأَمْطَرَتْ ۞ وَأَسْأَلُكَ اللّٰهُمَّ بِالأَسْمَاءِ الْمَكْتُوبَةِ فِي جَبْهَةِ سَيِّدِنَا إِسْرَافِيلَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ ۞ وَبِالْأَسْمَاءِ الْمَكْتُوبَةِ فِي جَبْهَةِ سَيِّدِنَا جِبْرِيلَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ ۞ وَعَلٰى الْمَلَائِكَةِ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ ۞ وَأَسْأَلُكَ اللّٰهُمَّ بِالْأَسْمَاءِ الْمَكْتُوبَةِ حَوْلَ الْعَرْشِ ۞ وَبِالأَسْمَاءِ الْمَكْتُوبَةِ حَوْلَ الْكُرْسِيِّ ۞ وَأَسْأَلُكَ اللّٰهُمَّ بِالاسْمِ الْمَكْتُوبِ عَلٰى وَرَقِ الزَّيْتُونِ ۞ وَأَسْأَلُكَ اللّٰهُمَّ بِالأَسْمَاءِ الْعِظَامِ الَّتِي سَمَّيْتَ بِهَا نَفْسَكَ، مَا عَلِمْتُ مِنْهَا، وَمَا لَمْ أَعْلَمْ
verses.tr: Allāhumma wa asʾaluka bil-ism alladhī wadaʿtahu ʿalā al-layl fa-aẓlama, wa ʿalā an-nahār fa-stanāra, wa ʿalā as-samāwāt fa-staqallat, wa ʿalā al-arḍ fa-staqarra, wa ʿalā al-jibāl farasat, wa ʿalā al-biḥār wal-awdiyah fajarat, wa ʿalā al-ʿuyūn fanabaʿat, wa ʿalā as-saḥāb fa-amṭarat. Wa asʾaluka allāhumma bil-asmāʾ al-maktūbah fī jabhat sayyidinā Isrāfīl ʿalayhis-salām, wa bil-asmāʾ al-maktūbah fī jabhat sayyidinā Jibrīl ʿalayhis-salām, wa ʿalā al-malāʾikatil-muqarrabīn. Wa asʾaluka allāhumma bil-asmāʾ al-maktūbah ḥawla al-ʿarsh, wa bil-asmāʾ al-maktūbah ḥawla al-kursī, wa asʾaluka allāhumma bil-ism al-maktūb ʿalā waraq az-zaytūn, wa asʾaluka allāhumma bil-asmāʾ al-ʿiẓām allatī sammayta bihā nafsak, mā ʿalimtu minhā wa mā lam aʿlam.
verses.en: O Allah, I ask You in the Name which when laid upon the night, darkness falls, and when laid upon the day, light appears, and when laid upon the Heavens, they are raised on high. And when laid upon the Earth, it becomes firm. And when laid upon the mountains, they become fixed and when laid upon the oceans and the rivers, they begin to flow. And when laid upon the springs, they burst forth. And when laid upon the clouds, they shed their rain. And I ask You, O Allah, in the Names written upon the forehead of Israfil, peace be upon him, and in the Names written upon the forehead on Gabriel, peace be upon him and upon all the angels of Intimacy. And I ask You, O Allah, in Names written around the Throne and in the Names written around the Footstool. And I ask You, O Allah, in the name written on the olive leaf. And I ask You, O Allah, in the Greatest Names which You have named Yourself knowledge of which I have and which I will never have.
